name: smwmusic-sonic-the-hedgehog-ms-gg-atlantic-criminal-labyrinth-zone-remix
title: Sonic the Hedgehog (MS/GG) - Atlantic Criminal ~ Labyrinth Zone (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of the fourth zone in Sonic 1 (8-bit), Labyrinth Zone. Didn't take too much time to make this one, but it was still lots of fun.

This is probs my favorite song in the entire game. It's super freaking catchy and memorable compared to the slower-paced genesis version, even if that one is more well-known for all the wrong reasons lol.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. B Minor (Custom Pitch)
